title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-20
lineage: MAC (Taped by Cary Wolfson, Sony 1-point stereo mic > Sony TC-124) > Nak Dragon playback > ART DI/O > HD > Cool Edit 2000 > master CD > EAC>  SHN

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience recording of a high‑energy 1973 show with standout China Cat Sunflower → New Rider transition and a smoking Promised Land → Bertha → The Greatest stretch.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its fire – especially the seamless China Cat Sunflower into New Rider segue, Jerry’s soaring guitar work, and a monster Promised Land → Bertha → The Greatest sequence.  The tape is an audience (AUD) capture that sounds cloudy and muddy in places, but the musical excitement shines through.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong show quality (high energy, standout jams) outweighs a consistently muddy audience recording; most reviewers rate it 4‑5 stars despite sound issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio is described as cloudy, muddy and not up to modern standards; some moments sound surprisingly clear (almost like a soundboard), but overall the tape has limited fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Free‑form setlists with a solid first set and a killer second set; transitions are praised, especially China Cat Sunflower into New Rider.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry's guitar work peaking and his tone being perfect on this night.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir is highlighted as “on” – a great show for a Weir fan with strong rhythm/vocal contributions.
